senses.gloss: SV0009 आत्मा ātmā Soul or spirit: principle of life and sensation ,the individual self; the only conscious element in the human body

SV0010 आत्मानमाभिसमीक्ष्य ātmānamābhisamīkṣya After due consideration to the self-one should indulge in taking food. Individual should keenly assess quantity and quality of the food with respect to his constitution and self. This helps to yield the healthy effect over the body.
